scoring_justification: T3 structural: the paper's claims are qualitative trends (higher CB-MC average energy, moderate tail increase, energy broadening) and exact numeric match is not reported. Structural checks on ordering, tail ratio, and residual variance reflect the paper's conclusions.

outputs.description: Average electron energy for traditional and CB‑MC simulations at each applied field. Used to check that CB‑MC energy > traditional and both increase monotonically with field.
Energy distribution histogram at 10 kV/cm. Used to verify a moderate high‑energy tail increase (CB/traditional tail ratio in [1.0,2.0]) and absence of a runaway peak.
Scatter data of electron energy vs |p| at 10 kV/cm. Used to check that CB‑MC shows energy broadening (variance > 1e-6 in several momentum bins) while traditional does not.

output_contract.notes: Structural scoring tier T3: ordering, tail ratio, and variance checks only; no exact numeric gold values are required. The agent must run both MC simulations to obtain realistic statistics; fabricated data that happens to pass the structural audits cannot be ruled out, but the workflow design forces genuine execution through the load‑bearing average‑energy step.

steps.description: Verify CB-MC average energy strictly exceeds traditional at each field and both sequences increase monotonically with field.
Verify tail ratio of CB-MC to traditional energy distribution at 10 kV/cm is in [1.0,2.0] with partial credit for extended range.
Verify CB-MC shows significant broadening (energy residuals >100x traditional) at 10 kV/cm.
